claims.statement: Let Lambda be a supplied bistochastic CPTP map, B0 a supplied symmetric broadcaster with bistochastic HS-selfadjoint marginal Phi0, and Psi0 a finite canonical EB comparator. If I-Psi0 <= c(I-Phi0)+delta I and c+delta>=1, then Phi=Lambda* Phi0 Lambda is bistochastic HS-selfadjoint and self-compatible, Psi=Lambda* Psi0 Lambda is finite canonical EB, and I-Psi <= c(I-Phi)+delta I on the full Hermitian operator space.
assumptions: Lambda is completely positive, trace preserving, and unital; Lambda need not be Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint.
B0 is a symmetric CPTP broadcaster for Phi0; Phi0 and the canonical comparator Psi0 are unital, trace preserving, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint.
The core operator comparison holds on the full Hermitian space or on the traceless space with identity fixed and no identity/traceless cross block.
For the order transfer, c+delta>=1; in the exact case delta=0 this is c>=1.
claims.status: internally derived standard closure; independent proof audit passed; not claimed as new prior art
costs: For a global Kraus list of q Lambda operators and r0 core broadcaster Kraus operators, the expanded dressed broadcaster has at most q^3*r0 Kraus operators.
A core canonical EB map with S outcomes yields S pulled-back outcomes; explicitly forming them costs O(S q d^3) dense arithmetic and O(S d^2) output entries.

For a supplied depth-D local circuit of bistochastic gates on L sites, keep the adjoint circuit in reverse order; the wrapper costs O(LD) local channel operations plus the core implementation. A flattened product instrument may still have 3^L outcome strings.
claims.falsifier: A failure of any bistochastic premise, a counterexample to the factorization identity in equation (1) of FINAL_REPORT.md, or a pulled effect/state failing the exact canonical sums/denominator identity.
claims.novelty_boundary: Compatibility and EB processing closure are standard. The contribution here is an explicit order-preserving wrapper for a supplied structured core; it does not solve arbitrary interacting or capacity-only broadcasting.

claims.statement: For the d=4 CNOT-dressed qubit-broadcaster core and the rational-entry bistochastic but non-HS-selfadjoint local channel Lambda=(Ad_V o (3/4 Id+1/4 Ad_Z)) tensor Id with V=I/3+(2i/3)X+(2i/3)Y, the composed broadcaster has 128 exact weighted Kraus terms and equal marginals Phi=Lambda* Phi0 Lambda; the nine-outcome pulled-back canonical EB map Psi=Lambda* Psi0 Lambda satisfies I-Psi<=2(I-Phi) exactly on all 16 Hermitian modes.
assumptions: All weights, Kraus entries, and unitary entries are exact rational-complex values; no numerical rounding is used.
The core broadcaster and core factor-two comparator are the serialized cycle-7 CNOT-dressed two-site example.
claims.status: finite exact computation; not a generic many-body compiler demonstration
costs: Two qubit sites, global Hilbert dimension 4, two Lambda Kraus operators, 16 core broadcaster Kraus operators, 128 expanded composed broadcaster Kraus terms, and nine comparator outcomes.
The exact pivoted LDL check reports 15 positive pivots and a zero identity-mode direction; both final transfer matrices have nonzero off-diagonal entries in the core Pauli basis.
claims.falsifier: Recompute the output matrices and obtain a failed Kraus TP sum, unequal marginal PTMs, failed canonical POVM/preparation sums, a non-PSD exact slack, or a symmetric Lambda PTM.
claims.next_gate: Audit implementation of finite-depth bistochastic noise circuits with local adjoint gates and preserve their outcome instrument in circuit form without expanding 3^L effects.

claims.statement: Under the core comparison and bistochastic sandwich hypotheses, any promised tracial likelihood family rho_H=(I+H)/d with tau(H)=0, ||H||infinity<=theta<1, and sup ||(I-Phi)H||_(1,tau)<=r is reconstructed by one common canonical EB map Psi with ordinary physical half-trace error at most one half sqrt(c theta r+delta theta^2).
assumptions: The all-mode operator comparison from C4-C8-BISTOCHASTIC-ADJOINT-SANDWICH-CLOSURE holds.
The family-specific near-fixedness bound r and the operator bound theta are supplied promises; a Holevo bound alone does not imply them.
claims.status: internal corollary of the standard sandwich closure and canonical-map spectral bound; no application claim or priority claim
costs: The bound has no explicit dimension or family-cardinality factor once the all-mode comparison is supplied.
Acquiring or verifying a promised whole-family residual bound is outside this result.
claims.falsifier: A violation of the canonical-map contraction inequality or trace-norm/physical-normalization calculation under the stated promises.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a conditional reconstruction corollary; the structured factorization and uniform slow-mode promise are supplied, not inferred from bounded Holevo information.
